newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares, in holiday mood, move little.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares, in holiday mood, move little.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index was little moved in light trading on Thursday ahead of the start next Monday of a two-week long vacation, traders said.
The index edged up 0.07 points or 0.11 percent to 65.508 points, on volume of 4.9 million shares worth $1.9 million.
The Shanghai Stock Exchange will close from Monday, February 3 until Monday, February 17 for the Chinese Lunar New Year holiday.
"The holiday mood has gripped the market, with few investors willing to build significant positions," said one trader. "So there was little movement of the index and volume was thin."
"The market was dominated by a little institutional speculative trading this morning," said a second trader. "It will consolidate at the current level before the holiday."
Of 43 B shares, 38 traded with 15 up, 10 flat and 13 down.
Dazhong Taxi was the star on speculative buying, rising $0.024 or three percent to $0.820 on volume of 25,000 shares.
Forever Bicycle followed on a technical rebound, gaining $0.004 or 2.59 percent to $0.158 on volume of 92,000 shares.
Market giant Chlor Alkali was the most active stock on inter-institutional trading, ending the morning unchanged at $0.318 on volume of 823,800 shares.

Shanghai's A share index fell at midday on profit-taking after consecutive rises in the past few days, but trading was slow with most investors sidelined ahead of the holiday, brokers said. It shed 2.395 points or 0.24 percent to 1001.776 points on volume of 132.5 million shares worth 1.2 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 blue-chip index dipped 8.173 points or 0.31 percent to 2600.493 points.
New Asia Fast Food was the biggest loser on profit-taking after yesterday's surge, slipping 0.45 yuan or 5.42 percent to 7.85 yuan on volume of 187,000 shares.
